question: Let ΔABC ~ ΔPQR and frac{operatorname{ar}(triangle {ABC})}{operatorname{ar}(triangle {QPR})}=(64)/(169) { } If AB = 10 cm, BC = 7 cm and AC = 16 cm, then PR (in cm) is equal to:
solution:
**Given:**

ΔABC ~ ΔPQR

ar(ΔABC)/ar(ΔQPR) = 64/169

AB = 10 cm, BC = 7 cm and AC = 16 cm

**Concept used:**

The ratio of the areas of two similar triangles is equal to the ratio of the squares of the corresponding sides

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c416e19658a37a9863e5e1dab09edaaf955230a9d054e459e2e6befead6f7cba.png] 

ar(ΔABC)/ar(ΔQPR) = AC²/PR²

⇒ 64/169 = 162/PR2

⇒ 8/13 = 16/PR

⇒ PR = (13 × 16)/8 = 26 cm

**∴ PR (in cm) is equal to 26 cm**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__**ΔABC ~ ΔPQR is important 

It does not matter what is given in the ratio form, 

That is frac{operatorname{ar}(triangle {ABC})}{operatorname{ar}(triangle {QPR})}

Hence we always solve the question according to ΔABC ~ ΔPQR.
